segments.name: Analog Products, MEMS and Sensors ("AM&S")
segments.description: Designs and sells analog ICs, MEMS sensors and actuators, and optical sensing solutions for automotive, industrial, personal electronics and communications customers.
segments.evidence: Analog Products, MEMS and Sensors ("AM&S") reportable segment, comprised of ST analog products, MEMS sensors and actuators, and optical sensing solutions.

segments.name: Power and Discrete products ("P&D")
segments.description: Supplies discrete and power transistor products, including power devices and protection devices, to automotive, industrial and personal electronics customers.
segments.evidence: Power and Discrete products ("P&D") reportable segment, comprised of discrete and power transistor products.

segments.name: Embedded Processing ("EMP")
segments.description: Provides general-purpose and automotive microcontrollers, connected security products and custom automotive ADAS processing products to industrial and automotive customers.
segments.evidence: Embedded Processing ("EMP") reportable segment, comprised of general-purpose and automotive microcontrollers, connected security products and custom processing products (automotive ADAS).

segments.name: RF Optical Communications ("RFOC")
segments.description: Delivers space, ranging and connectivity products, digital audio and signaling solutions and optical and RF ASICs to satellite, networking and data center customers.
segments.evidence: RF Optical Communications ("RFOC") reportable segment, comprised of space, ranging & connectivity products, digital audio & signaling solutions and optical & RF COT.

revenueModel.text: Customers and distributors pay for semiconductor products and solutions used across automotive, industrial, personal electronics and communications equipment markets.
revenueModel.evidence: A substantial portion of our sales is derived from a limited number of customers and distributors.

changes.text: In 2025, the newly created Embedded Processing reportable segment took in the former MCU segment and custom processing (automotive ADAS) products.
changes.evidence: the newly created 'Embedded Processing' reportable segment includes the former 'MCU' segment (excluding the RF ASICs mentioned below) as well as custom processing products (automotive ADAS products).

changes.text: In 2025, RF Optical Communications was created from the former D&RF segment and some RF ASICs previously part of the former EMP segment.
changes.evidence: the newly created 'RF Optical Communications' reportable segment includes the former 'D&RF' segment (excluding Automotive ADAS products) as well as some RF ASICs which were previously part of the former 'EMP' segment.

changes.text: In 2025, VIPpower products were transferred from the P&D reportable segment to the AM&S reportable segment.
changes.evidence: the transfer of VIPpower products from the P&D reportable segment to the AM&S reportable segment.
